item.title: Kenya confirms third Ebola case as health officials race to contain outbreak
item.description: Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, raising concerns over the spread of the deadly virus across East Africa. The Health Ministry says the latest patient is a 65-year-old woman and a close relative of the country’s first two cases. She had been in quarantine since October 6.
item.author: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: DR Congo bans activities of 13 political parties linked to Joseph Kabila as opposition cries repression
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo’s government has banned the activities of 13 political parties, including the PPRD of former president Joseph Kabila. Presented as a national security measure, the decision has divided the political class and reignited debate over democratic pluralism in the country.
item.author: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: Rights group says eastern Libyan authorities are carrying out executions
item.description: Human Rights Watch says the military has killed an estimated 31 people since late August, with at least 50 other people at risk.
item.author: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)
